opening.argument: The video presents an apparent interview about earnings associated with Forsage: the speaker says, “earn profit to 50K in 10 month,” and identifies herself as someone who owns a house in Bihar. The frame likewise displays “10 month me 50k ki earnings.” Those are promotional-sounding earnings claims, but they do not establish a deceptive solicitation. The supplied material shows no request to join, pay money, provide data, or follow a destination. It therefore supports reading the video as financial news and market analysis about the platform, not as a demonstrated attempt to solicit viewers.
